provider_proposal.incident_summary: Synthetic SEV2 alert for delayed execution acknowledgements affecting execution-service and fix-gateway. Returned evidence shows ack latency breach, repeated FIX disconnect/reconnect behavior, sequence gaps, retransmissions, and ACK_UNCERTAIN states during the investigation window.

alternative_hypotheses.reason: A small Kafka consumer lag is present, but it is not materially elevated relative to the observed incident symptoms and does not explain the FIX heartbeat timeout, reconnect attempts, or sequence gaps.
Quote-service metrics do not show CPU saturation or database pressure; the sampled values remain low/normal and do not align with the delayed execution acknowledgements.
Although FIX instability is the strongest supported domain, the evidence does not identify the initiating cause of the session degradation (for example, network, peer, or infrastructure fault).

recommended_next_steps: Review FIX session logs and peer connectivity around 14:01:24Z-14:02:12Z for the cause of the heartbeat timeout and reconnect loop.
Check network/device telemetry between execution-service and fix-gateway for packet loss, firewall resets, or session resets during the incident window.
Correlate FIX sequence-gap events with gateway restarts or peer session renegotiation, if available, to determine whether this was local or upstream.
Verify whether retransmitted messages were eventually acknowledged before any business escalation; do not resubmit orders blindly.
If the problem is ongoing, page the on-call owner for FIX/session infrastructure and capture a fresh snapshot of the session state before remediation.
limitations: No runbook or historical incident records were returned for this investigation, so no direct procedural or historical comparison could be cited.
Returned telemetry provides returned-sample coverage only; it does not prove continuous health or continuous failure across the full window.
The investigation identifies a supported failure domain but not the root initiating cause of the FIX instability.
Business events show acknowledgements uncertain and retransmissions, but they do not establish final execution state beyond the returned samples.

rca.executive_summary: Execution acknowledgements were delayed because the FIX pathway showed session instability: heartbeat timeout, repeated disconnect/reconnect attempts, sequence gaps, and retransmissions coincided with elevated acknowledgement latency.
rca.impact: Two sampled RFQs experienced ACK_PENDING and ACK_UNCERTAIN states, with execution acknowledgement latency breaching the deadline and continuing above threshold in later samples. Business impact is limited to the sampled RFQs because only returned event evidence is available.

FIX gateway showed instability with heartbeat timeout, repeated disconnect/reconnect attempts, and sequence-gap errors. [LOG-002-002]

FIX connection status, reconnect count, and sequence gaps were abnormal in sampled metrics. [METRIC-002-SERIES-FIX-GATEWAY-FIX_CONNECTION_STATUS-4, METRIC-002-SERIES-FIX-GATEWAY-FIX_CONNECTION_STATUS-5, METRIC-002-SERIES-FIX-GATEWAY-FIX_RECONNECT_COUNT-4, METRIC-002-SERIES-FIX-GATEWAY-FIX_RECONNECT_COUNT-5, METRIC-002-SERIES-FIX-GATEWAY-FIX_SEQUENCE_GAPS-4, METRIC-002-SERIES-FIX-GATEWAY-FIX_SEQUENCE_GAPS-5]

Business events show ACK_PENDING, ACK_UNCERTAIN, and FIX retransmission states for the sampled orders. [BUSINESS-002-006, BUSINESS-002-007, BUSINESS-002-008, BUSINESS-002-014, BUSINESS-002-015, BUSINESS-002-016]
Later log evidence indicates order acknowledgement remained uncertain while FIX connectivity was degraded. [LOG-002-003]
rca.probable_root_cause: Supported failure condition: FIX connectivity/session instability in the execution-service to fix-gateway path. The investigation does not identify the initiating cause of the instability.
contributing_factors: Repeated reconnect attempts and sequence gaps are consistent with a degraded FIX session.
Elevated execution latency may have compounded visible acknowledgement delays.
Returned samples do not show a compensating recovery within the frozen window.
immediate_next_steps: Check the FIX peer/session for disconnect cause, heartbeat configuration, and sequence reset/recovery state.
Correlate with network and host-level telemetry around 14:01:24Z-14:02:12Z.
Confirm whether any acknowledgements arrived after the cutoff before declaring the affected orders complete.
Preserve logs and session state for human-led investigation before any remediation.
follow_up_work: Add alerting for sustained ACK_UNCERTAIN plus reconnect/sequence-gap combinations.
Review whether heartbeat thresholds are tuned appropriately for observed traffic patterns.
Create a runbook for session recovery verification and post-incident order-state reconciliation.
Investigate whether monitoring gaps exist for the actual upstream transport fault that triggered the session instability.

showcase.title: FIX session instability
showcase.snapshot_label: Complete recorded evidence snapshot; independent of simulated animation progress. Cutoff is not continuous sample coverage.

identified: The proposal identifies FIX instability and distinguishes pending/uncertain acknowledgements from completion [LOG-002-002, BUSINESS-002-006, BUSINESS-002-007, BUSINESS-002-014, BUSINESS-002-015].
Recorded retransmissions retain the same economic order identities; no new economic order or confirmed fill is established [BUSINESS-002-008, BUSINESS-002-016].
overstatements: Its executive summary says acknowledgements were delayed 'because' of FIX instability; concurrent observations support the failure condition but do not prove that causal chain.

Its quote-service CPU exclusion cites database/stale-price rows, but no quote-service CPU sample was returned. Normal pricing/database rows cannot rule out intermittent alternatives or establish health through the 15:00 UTC cutoff.

The cited standalone acknowledgement sample is 4650 ms; the separate last series row establishes 4900 ms. A valid citation does not make every surrounding numerical claim supported [METRIC-002-ACK, METRIC-002-SERIES-EXECUTION-SERVICE-EXECUTION_ACK_LATENCY_MS-5].
unknowns: The initiating session failure, counterparty processing state and acknowledgement outcome after 14:02:24 UTC remain unknown. Blind order resubmission is unsafe without reconciliation.
validator_changes: The recorded gate accepted the failure domain and normalized 17 fields, including causal prose and observations. Its rewrites are rule-authored; they do not independently establish that each original field was erroneous.
The final advisory leaves the initiating cause unconfirmed and requires human review. Model and rule support scores are distinct and uncalibrated.
